shots.name: full-car-hook
shots.intent: The car fills roughly 88% of the frame in a clean dark studio.

shots.name: whip-orbit
shots.intent: Camera whips 220 degrees around the assembled car and brakes hard.

shots.name: three-beat-explode
shots.intent: Roof and hood, then doors and wheels, then interior and chassis separate in three rapid tiers.

shots.name: exploded-observation
shots.intent: Camera drifts 15 degrees and pushes in while the exploded assembly remains large.

shots.name: magnetic-collapse
shots.intent: Every rigid group returns to its assembled transform and settles with weight.

shots.name: reverse-orbit
shots.intent: Camera reverses to the opening angle.

shots.name: loop-breath
shots.intent: Clean full-car hold returning exactly to the opening composition.
